librarySection.title: Library Location
librarySection.desc: Choose the local folder where your 3D models (STL, 3MF) are stored.

visionSection.title: Visual Enrichment (Vision AI)
visionSection.desc: Enriches your 3D models by generating descriptive tags and titles using vision AI models.

embeddingSection.title: Embedding Service
embeddingSection.desc: Turns AI descriptions and your search queries into vectors. The built-in model runs locally and is downloaded once from Hugging Face.
embeddingSection.reembedConfigChanged: The embedding configuration changed, so stored embeddings were cleared. Run "Re-embed library" to make semantic search work again.
embeddingSection.footnote: Changing the embedding provider or model changes the vector space: existing embeddings are cleared and the library needs to be re-embedded before search works. The built-in model (~25 MB) is downloaded from Hugging Face on first use and then works fully offline.

appearanceSection.title: Appearance
appearanceSection.desc: Customize the look and feel of meshNest. Choose between a light interface, the Deep Nebula dark mode, or follow your operating system's theme.
